formal_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → (∀ j < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ p0 l0 : Fin N, ¬ I p0 l0 → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ke : Fin (N + N) => decide (ke = Fin.castAdd N p0 ∨ ke = Fin.natAdd N l0)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) → (∀ j < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) → ∃ (D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (P L : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) D ∧ D.size ≤ 5 * C.size ∧ (∀ y : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D y = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ y (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ y (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ w ∈ P, w < N ∨ ∃ i < D.gates.length, w = N + N + i ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∀ u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs, u ∈ P) ∧ (∀ w ∈ L, (N ≤ w ∧ w < N + N) ∨ ∃ i < D.gates.length, w = N + N + i ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∀ u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs, u ∈ L) ∧ ∀ i < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ a b : ℕ, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs = [a, b] ∧ ((a ∈ P ∧ b ∈ L) ∨ (a ∈ L ∧ b ∈ P))
plain_statement: N points, N lines, no two points on two common lines; inputs points then lines. C: AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two, each reading only earlier wires, true exactly when an incident pair is on; every AND gate false at each input with one input on and at each input of one point and one line not incident. Then some circuit D of the same kind with at most 5 size(C) gates computes the same function, each AND of D reading a point input or OR of such, and a line input or OR of such.
title: 4-cycle-free incidence: an AND/OR circuit computing it with ANDs off at one-hot and non-incident pairs has a rewrite, at most 5 times its gates, in two levels
